heroTitle: Windows and doors, built to measure.
heroSubtitle: PVC and thermal aluminium windows, doors, shutters and railings, designed, manufactured and installed by MK AluPlast since 1999.

steps.title: Consultation & measuring
steps.text: Tell us about your project, the type of product, approximate dimensions and location, and we arrange an on-site measurement.

steps.title: Profile & glass selection
steps.text: We help you choose the right profile system, glazing and opening type for your space, comfort goals and budget.

steps.title: Manufacturing
steps.text: Your windows and doors are made to your exact measurements and requirements, with quality materials and careful workmanship.

steps.title: Installation
steps.text: Our team plans and carries out a professional, carefully sealed installation, delivering a secure, energy-efficient result built to last.
